# AimBytes

> > AimBytes is a Gurgaon-based digital agency specializing in web development (React, Next.js, TypeScript), mobile apps (iOS, Android, React Native), AI integration, and full-stack solutions with 24/7 technical support.

Founded in 2020, AimBytes delivers enterprise-grade development services with expertise in modern JavaScript frameworks, microservices architecture, and AI-powered applications. The team, led by Pranav Arya, focuses on scalable solutions using technologies like Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Kubernetes.

## Key Topics

- React & Next.js development
- TypeScript patterns
- React Native mobile apps
- AI integration (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini)
- Microservices architecture
- Node.js & Express.js
- PostgreSQL & MongoDB
- Kubernetes & cloud-native
- Performance optimization
- Full-stack solutions
- iOS & Android development
- Tailwind CSS
- GraphQL & REST APIs
- 24/7 maintenance & support
- Enterprise application patterns
